steps: kubectl apply: Deployment web (3 replicas, nginx:1.27-alpine, readiness probe httpGet / on port 80 with initialDelaySeconds 60 and periodSeconds 5, strategy RollingUpdate maxSurge 1 maxUnavailable 0) and ClusterIP Service web (port 80)
wait until the new ReplicaSet has one pod Running with Ready=False (before its first readiness probe)
capture the namespace resources and the cluster nodes and persistentvolumes
